4 اسعلهُ It [made him to cough, or] occasioned him a coughing. (TA.) ＝
-A2- And (assumed tropical:) He, or it, made him, or pronounced him, to be like the سِعْلَاة [q. v.]. (O, TA.) ―
-b2- And (assumed tropical:) He. (a man, K, TA,) and it, (pasture, or herbage, O, TA,) rendered him (a horse, TA) brisk, lively, or sprightly; (O, K, TA;) as also أَزْعَلَهُ. (O, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
